err.access_off: That way of opening the tablet is switched off on this server.
err.not_at_desk: Stand at the mission desk to open the tablet there.
err.desk_department: This mission desk is not for your department.
err.no_tablet_item: You need the police tablet in your inventory.
health.check_failed: This check could not run: the server console has the error
health.item.off: The tablet item is off: every way opens the tablet without it
health.item.require_no_item: requireItem is on but Config.Tablet.item is not set: only mission desks can open the tablet
health.item.no_inventory: ox_inventory is not running: the tablet item {item} cannot be checked or used
health.item.missing: {item} is not an ox_inventory item: paste items/ox_inventory_items.lua into ox_inventory (items/README.md)
health.item.ok: The tablet item {item} exists in ox_inventory
health.item.way_off: {item} is set but Config.Tablet.access.item is false: using the item does nothing
health.desk.coords: Desk {n} ({label}): coords is not a vec3, so the desk is left out
health.desk.size: Desk {n} ({label}): size is not a vec3
health.desk.no_target: ox_target is not running: no mission desk can be used
health.colour.ok: Department colours and personal accents are valid
health.colour.theme: {dept}: theme.{key} is not a 6-digit hex colour (a default is used)
health.colour.accent: {dept}: personal accent {n} is not a 6-digit hex colour and is left out
health.colour.accent_level: {dept}: personal accent {n} has a level that is not a whole number of 1 or more
health.tweak.unknown: Config.MissionTweaks.{id}: there is no mission with that id
health.tweak.ignored: Config.MissionTweaks.{id} was ignored: the server console says why
health.locale.missing: locales/en.json is missing: every text shows its key
health.locale.invalid: locales/en.json is not valid JSON: every text shows its key
health.locale.not_en: Config.Locale is {code}, but English is the only language shipped: English is used
health.avatar.ok: Profile picture links allowed from {n} hosts
health.avatar.no_hosts: Profile picture links are on, but no valid host is allowed: every link is refused
health.avatar.bad_host: Avatar host {host} is not a host name and is never matched
health.avatar.expiring: Avatar host {host} serves links that expire: pictures from it break after a day
health.avatar.no_approval: Profile picture links need no approval: any allowed link shows at once
health.item.no_image: ox_inventory/web/images has no {item}.png, so the item shows no picture: copy crimson_police_tablet.png from this resource's items folder into ox_inventory/web/images and name it {item}.png
health.dept.no_jobs: Qbox gave no job list, so the department jobs could not be checked: make sure qbx_core started without errors
health.dept.no_job: {dept}: Qbox has no job named {job}, so nobody can use this department. Add the job to qbx_core/shared/jobs.lua, or put your own police job name in the department's jobs in Admin UI → Departments (or Config.Departments.{key} in config/config.lua)
health.dept.no_job_other: {dept}: Qbox has no job named {job}, so that name does nothing (players with the department's other jobs can still use it). Fix or remove the name in the department's jobs in Admin UI → Departments (or Config.Departments.{key} in config/config.lua)
health.dept.grade_high: {dept}: supervisorGrade is {grade}, higher than every grade of Qbox job {job} ({ladder}), so nobody is a supervisor. Set the department's supervisor grade in Admin UI → Departments (or Config.Departments.{key} in config/config.lua) to the grade number supervisors start at
health.dept.grade_all: {dept}: supervisorGrade {grade} is the lowest grade of Qbox job {job} ({ladder}), so every officer is a supervisor. Raise the department's supervisor grade in Admin UI → Departments (or Config.Departments.{key} in config/config.lua) unless that is what you want
health.dept.ok: {dept}: Qbox job {job} ({ladder}); supervisors are grade {first} and up
health.admin.ace: Server admins (group.admin) have {ace}, so they can open the Admin UI
health.admin.qbox: Qbox admins (group.admin) can open the Admin UI, because Config.QboxAdmins is true
health.admin.none: No admin group can open the Admin UI yet. Add this line to server.cfg and restart: add_ace group.admin {ace} allow (skip it if you give {ace} to each admin yourself)
health.admin.unchecked: Admins are players with the {ace} permission; this server cannot check which group has it
health.folder.renamed: This resource's folder is named {name}, not {expected}. The tablet works, but the tablet item only opens it when its line in ox_inventory/data/items.lua reads export = '{name}.useTablet' (other scripts must also call exports['{name}']). Change that line, or rename the folder back to {expected}. This line shows while the folder has another name
health.folder.renamed_no_item: This resource's folder is named {name}, not {expected}: everything works. If you add the tablet item later, its line in ox_inventory/data/items.lua must read export = '{name}.useTablet', and other scripts must call exports['{name}']
health.res.sc_police: sc-police is not running. Crimson-Police still works, but officers cannot set their callsign with /callsign, and officers suspended in sc-dispatch are not kept off duty. Add ensure sc-police to server.cfg if you use it
health.webhook.summary: Discord webhooks on: {on}. Off: {off} (optional: set cp_webhook_<name> in server.cfg)
health.webhook.invalid: {convar} in server.cfg is not an https:// link, so that webhook is off. Use: set {convar} "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/..."
health.startup_ok: Start-up check: all {ok} checks passed. Type {cmd} check in the server console to see them
health.startup_problems: Start-up check: {warn} warnings and {error} errors (each on its own line above, with the fix), {ok} checks passed. Type {cmd} check in the server console to see every line again
